issues.evidence: 18 of 26 hook cuts measure no sound event (1.2, 5.07, 8.0, 13.93, 15.6, 16.5, 22.97, 24.07, 24.87, 31.07, 31.83, 34.5, 35.0, 36.77, 37.4, 39.2, 40.3, 45.63). The added whoosh2 touches at 0.18 are too soft to register under the beds and the VO.
issues.suggested_action: Replace the 0.18 whoosh2 with fast-attack transients (tick, swish or air-cut) at 0.3–0.4, starting 0–30 ms before each cut.

issues.evidence: 70 per-key clicks are cued from typing_keys.json, but only 9 onsets are detected across the three typing passages (e.g., none between 7.55 and 9.7 although 14 keys fall there). Some key gaps are 30–40 ms (8.41/8.45/8.48, 30.23/30.26, 30.95/30.98), which sounds like a flam, not a human keystroke.
issues.suggested_action: Raise key clicks to 0.3–0.4 with ±2 dB variation, use 3–4 different key samples, and enforce a minimum of 70 ms between clicks (merge closer ones).

issues.evidence: The real protagonist inserts (head in hands at about 23, head scratch at about 33, frustrated reaction at 35–37) have no cloth, chair or breath foley. Only the head drop at 44.57 has a thud.
issues.suggested_action: Add a cloth rustle plus a chair creak at 23.0, a hair or scratch rustle at 33, and an exhale at 35.5 (0.15–0.25).

issues.evidence: The real lights come on at 107.9, and only the identity sting (non-diegetic) marks it. No switch or lamp sound is heard.
issues.suggested_action: Add a soft switch click or lamp tick at 107.85 under the sting, plus a faint electrical hum fade-in.

issues.evidence: The cold open has a phone buzz at 0.05 while the frame shows only the laptop email with the cards. No phone is visible.
issues.suggested_action: Keep it (it reads as an off-screen alarm), or swap it for a mail-received ping on the email client so that it ties to the picture.

issues.evidence: Accept-all uses pop_long plus an impact. The Priya Accept at 99 uses pop.mp3. The 'accept' sound family is close but not identical, so the signature sound is diluted.
issues.suggested_action: Use one signature accept sound (pop_long), scaled by size: full at 86.3, 60% on the single Priya proposal (99.0).

issues.evidence: From 37.35 to 41.75 there are 5 whooshes, an impact, 4 buzzes, a clock and a buzz plus bell, all stacked with the riser and the heartbeat. This is intentional overload, but it risks cartoonish density under the VO 'Five tabs. Copy. Paste…'.
issues.suggested_action: Keep the whip whooshes on the words (Copy/Paste/Check/Repeat) and thin the notification buzzes to 2.

constraint_failures.rule: more than 50% of cuts with no sound event in a film that claims urgency
constraint_failures.evidence: 31 of 45 cuts in cuts_without_sound_event_s (69%); 18 of 26 in the hook

spotting_list.event: cuts in the fix-by-hand and deck sequence

top_revision: Re-spot every hook cut and product cut with an audible fast-attack transient (0.3–0.4, 0–30 ms before the cut) and make the per-key clicks audible and humanly spaced (≥70 ms), so that the 69% of cuts with no sound event drops below 30%.
